sources.title: Eswatini Government: immigrant visa-requirement schedule
sources.publisher: Ministry of Home Affairs / Government of Eswatini
sources.officialityEvidence: The current government portal publishes a country-by-country table expressly headed “Visa required (Y=yes N=no)” and gives the Home Affairs visitor-visa application context.

sources.title: Eswatini Ministry of Home Affairs eVisa guidelines
sources.officialityEvidence: The official gov.sz eVisa portal’s guidance says the need for a visa depends on country of origin, but it gives no country selector or eligibility schedule. The separately reviewed FAQ supplies the electronic-issuance facts.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Whether you need a visa or not to enter and stay in Eswatini as a tourist depends upon which country you are from.

sources.title: Eswatini eVisa FAQ
sources.officialityEvidence: The current official gov.sz eVisa portal FAQ expressly describes an electronically issued, pre-travel eVisa but limits it to unnamed eligible countries; it also says a visa on arrival is unavailable.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The eVisa for Eswatini is an electronic visa that allows eligible foreign citizens to apply for and obtain a visa online.

policies.title: Eswatini: unambiguous N-schedule ordinary passports — visa-free
policies.summary: The current Government schedule marks these unambiguous catalog countries N (no visa required). Conflicting South Korea and same-country rows are deliberately excluded.
conditions: The source labels N as no visa required; admission remains subject to Immigration examination, purpose and other requirements.
No duration, special-document, residence, work, transit or individual-admissibility entitlement is inferred.
South Korea has contradictory source rows; Eswatini’s same-country row is not citizenship evidence.

policies.title: Eswatini: unambiguous Y-schedule ordinary passports — advance visa required
policies.summary: The current Government schedule marks these unambiguous catalog countries Y (visa required). Its Home Affairs guidance directs visa applications to the Ministry or foreign missions. The eVisa portal does not publish an eligibility list, so this status is not normalized to eVisa.
conditions: Y means visa required on the cited government schedule. The same government guidance states applications are handled by Home Affairs or Eswatini missions.
The eVisa portal proves electronic issuance for eligible countries only; it does not identify which Y countries are eligible.

The Government schedule describes a narrow, case-specific visa-on-arrival procedure after a host or tourist undertakes that prior application was impossible, while the eVisa FAQ says VOA is unavailable. Neither source maps a nationality-wide ordinary-passport VOA entitlement, so no VOA policy is asserted.
